_about: Build-around profiles for unique items (tools/generate.py --build-around). Each says what the unique asks of the rest of the build, with where that comes from. 'gear': lines of the template rares to replace (template line -> new line). 'ignoreResistPenalty': resistances the score should not require at 75% because the unique makes them irrelevant for damage taken. 'skillTags': gem tags the main skill should have. 'armourBases': attribute whose armour bases the template gear uses (Str = armour), when the unique asks for a defence the class's own bases lack.

why: Nearby enemies have Lightning Resistance equal to yours: push your own lightning resistance down (to -200%) and the enemy's follows.
Lightning Resistance does not affect Lightning Damage taken, and Armour also applies to Lightning Damage from Hits: the negative resistance costs nothing, armour protects instead.
Deal no Non-Lightning Damage: the skill must deal lightning damage (or convert to it).
Real builds stack armour (20-33k): the template gear uses armour bases.
sources: 7 builds from poe.ninja, collected by hand 2026-11-25 (library tag "doryani's prototype"): all at -170% to -200% own lightning resistance, from rare rings with -67% to -140% lightning resistance (5 of 7 with Kalandra's Touch, several Thread of Hope); armour 20-33k except two block Gladiators.
PoB check on the Storm Call Assassin build: lightning resistance back to +73% costs 89% of its DPS, EHP unchanged.
